# Nexudyam

> Nexudyam is a lead-generation digital marketing and branding agency for startups and MSMEs across India. Nexudyam is a unit of Redside Technologies India. We fix what is broken between the click and the customer with high-intent Meta & Google Ads, conversion-ready Next.js websites, brand identity design, and AI-assisted content workflows.

Remote-first and operating nationwide across India, Nexudyam delivers transparent, high-ROI marketing packages designed for founders, small business owners, and multi-city service businesses with zero lock-in contracts.

## Core Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.nexudyam.in/): Overview of agency capabilities, lead generation solutions, client reviews, and pricing.
- [About Us](https://www.nexudyam.in/about): Mission, remote-first philosophy, and vision for Indian MSME growth.
- [Pricing](https://www.nexudyam.in/pricing): Transparent digital marketing packages (Launch ₹4,999/mo, Grow ₹9,999/mo, Scale ₹18,999/mo).
- [Blog](https://www.nexudyam.in/blog): Actionable guides on digital marketing, local SEO, and startup lead generation.
- [Contact](https://www.nexudyam.in/contact): Communication channels including WhatsApp (+91-9161881100), phone, and inquiry form.

## Solutions (Problems We Fix)

- [Ads Not Generating Leads](https://www.nexudyam.in/solutions/ads-not-generating-leads): Overhaul ad targeting parameters and add lead qualification filters to stop wasting ad spend on low-quality leads.
- [Website Not Converting](https://www.nexudyam.in/solutions/website-not-converting): Turn passive website traffic into direct WhatsApp inquiries and phone calls with high-speed Next.js architecture.
- [Not Showing on Google or Maps](https://www.nexudyam.in/solutions/not-showing-on-google): Dominate Google Maps 3-Pack and local search with verified Google Business Profile optimization.
- [Brand or Product Launch](https://www.nexudyam.in/solutions/brand-or-product-launch): Complete visual identity, launch-ready websites, and awareness campaigns for new startups.
- [Consistent Content Creation](https://www.nexudyam.in/solutions/consistent-content): 30-day AI-assisted social media calendars, Reels scripts, and graphics delivered in 48 hours.
- [Sell Online with Shopify](https://www.nexudyam.in/solutions/sell-online-shopify): Custom Shopify store development with Razorpay, COD OTP verification, and WhatsApp cart recovery.

## Core Services

- [Website Development](https://www.nexudyam.in/services/website-development): Fast, mobile-first, SEO-ready business websites built on Next.js.
- [Google Business Profile](https://www.nexudyam.in/services/google-business-profile): Setup, verification, optimization, and local review strategy for multi-city Google Maps ranking.
- [Meta & Google Ads](https://www.nexudyam.in/services/meta-google-ads): High-intent Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram) and Google Search ad management.
- [Brand Identity Design](https://www.nexudyam.in/services/brand-identity): Custom logo design, brand guidelines, typography hierarchies, and vector assets.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://www.nexudyam.in/services/social-media-marketing): Monthly content calendars, Instagram Reels strategy, graphics, and community growth.
- [AI Content Marketing](https://www.nexudyam.in/services/ai-content-marketing): Rapid video scripts, WhatsApp broadcast copy, and SEO articles with expert human review.
- [E-commerce Websites (Shopify)](https://www.nexudyam.in/ecom-websites): Custom Shopify store setup, payment gateway integration, and conversion optimization.
- [Event Promotion](https://www.nexudyam.in/events): Pre-event ads, live coverage coordination, and evergreen post-event content repurposing.
